description: Find associations near a specific city or postal code in France, optionally filtered by theme. Performs geographic search to return associations in the specified area, automatically widening to nearby communes (±25 km) when the exact area has no match. Useful for location-based queries like "AMAP near Les Hayes 41800" (query="amap", location="41800") or "chess clubs in Lyon" (query="échecs", location="Lyon").

location.description: ONLY the place: city name (e.g., "Lyon", "Les Hayes") or postal code (e.g., "69001", "41800"). Put the theme in `query`, never here.

query.description: Optional theme or keyword to search near the location (e.g., "amap", "échecs", "théâtre"). Without it, all associations of the area are returned.

name: search_near_location
